actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt, and leave it running.
required_artifacts: A listening TCP service on 127.0.0.1:6665 connected to QEMU serial/console
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully in the background
Telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 shows a login prompt
The VM remains running after readiness is achieved
known_invalid_patterns: Only confirming the ISO file exists
Only starting QEMU without exposing telnet on 6665
Only checking that port 6665 is open without reaching a login prompt
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and filesystem for the ISO and qemu availability
Launch QEMU with a telnet-capable serial/console on localhost:6665 in the background
Wait until the telnet endpoint is reachable and presents a login prompt
Record receipt-backed evidence of the running process and prompt visibility
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt showing localhost:6665 is reachable via telnet
Receipt showing the login prompt is displayed
notes: Prerequisites like qemu installation are not success by themselves; they only inform implementation.

plan.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt, and leave it running.
plan.current_focus: Discover available tools/files and launch QEMU with telnet-accessible console.
implementation_approach: Inspect filesystem and tool availability for /app/alpine.iso and qemu binary
Choose QEMU console/serial settings that expose a telnet server on 127.0.0.1:6665
Start QEMU in background and keep PID/receipt
Probe readiness until telnet shows login prompt
validation_strategy: Use measured evidence from command receipts rather than assumptions
Confirm the telnet endpoint is reachable and the prompt is visible
verification_test_strategy: Run a telnet connection to 127.0.0.1 6665 after launch
If needed, use probe_service or raw_bash to confirm readiness
known_bad_behavior: Treating file existence or process start alone as completion
Using a console configuration that does not expose telnet on 6665
evidence_gaps: Need evidence of ISO path accessibility
risks: The ISO may require specific boot parameters or console settings
Telnet may need a delay before prompt appears
next_steps: Launch VM with appropriate serial redirection
Verify prompt and keep VM running
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence of launch, reachable telnet endpoint, and login prompt

actions.command:
set -e
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
for c in qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-i386 qemu-system-aarch64 telnet nc socat timeout; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s=%s\n' "$c" "$(command -v "$c")" || true; done
ls -l /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
file /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
